tools.name: get_dmc_color
tools.description: Look up a DMC stranded cotton colour by its number ("310", "3865", "Blanc", "B5200"): name, hex and RGB, colour family.

tools.name: get_anchor_color
tools.description: Look up an Anchor stranded cotton colour by its number ("403", "2", "Anchor 403"): name, hex and RGB, colour family.

tools.name: find_nearest_dmc_colors
tools.description: Find the DMC threads closest to any colour (hex like #ff6600 or rgb(255,102,0)), ranked by CIEDE2000 colour difference, the same matching the pattern maker uses. deltaE below 2 is hard to tell apart; above 10 is clearly a different colour.

tools.name: list_dmc_colors
tools.description: List DMC stranded cotton colours (489 in total), optionally by colour family or by a search in the number and name.

tools.name: convert_thread
tools.description: Find the threads of the other brand closest to a DMC or Anchor thread, nearest first, each with its CIEDE2000 colour difference and a rating: same (deltaE below 2), close (below 5), noticeable (below 10) or far. Calculated by colour: approximate, not an official manufacturer equivalent.

tools.name: pattern_size
tools.description: For a cross-stitch pattern of width × height stitches on Aida 11, 14, 16 or 18: the finished size in cm and inches, the piece of fabric to cut (5 cm spare on each side) and how many full stitches one 8 m skein covers with 2 strands.

tools.name: search_articles
tools.description: Search PatternHoop blog articles about cross-stitch (choosing photos, Aida fabric, threads) in any of the seven site languages. Returns titles, summaries and links; every article page also answers Accept: text/markdown.
